scope: 3D relation-attention used in synth-only paper results

paper_recipe.hypothesis: A clean rerun of the independently selected attempt-13 relation-attention method will reproduce every outer prediction, score, and authoritative metric before terminal freezing.

architecture.initialization: PyTorch module defaults in construction order after torch.manual_seed(270901)

optimizer.parameter_group: all model.parameters(), including biases and LayerNorm parameters

training.sampling: all sets exactly once per epoch, no replacement
training.shuffle: torch.randperm with a separate CPU torch.Generator seeded 270901 once before epoch loop

loss.unused_target_column_warning: relation_positive exists but fit_model does not read it
loss.event_assignment: reuse matched_truth_event_id from attach_identity_labels; identity can affect ambiguous event assignment, not the binary spatial_positive definition
loss.weight_construction: after top-20 selection, independently in each training scene
loss.global_scaling: divide by average weight over all valid selected training rows
loss.logged_epoch_loss: sum of all update-time minibatch weighted-loss numerators divided by sum of denominators

preprocessing.context_score_percentile: pandas.Series.rank(method=average,pct=True) within all rows of the scene union
preprocessing.group_top3_mean: mean over min(3,group size) highest-scored candidates
preprocessing.group_rank: 0-based; score descending, candidate_frame ascending, source row ascending
preprocessing.topk_selection: stable descending base-score argsort within each vanished trajectory; ties preserve original candidate row order
preprocessing.relative_coordinates: cast frames and XYZ to float32 before top/mean subtraction; frame and micrometre units
preprocessing.validity_required_for_last_10: finite frame/XYZ and integer survivor IDs; no nan_to_num on additional 10 columns
preprocessing.normalization_fit: only valid top-20 rows from the training contexts in that fit; unweighted
preprocessing.normalization_statistics: compute float64 accumulation, cast mean/std to float32; ddof=0
preprocessing.normalization_apply: (x-mean)/std for all 46 columns including binary flags; overwrite padding with 0
preprocessing.inference_statistics: reuse training mean/std; do not refit on target scene

split.development_relation_fit: for held-out a, train relation and normalization on other 4 scenes; base score for training b is from 92-feature models excluding a and b
split.terminal_relation_fit: train relation and normalization on all 5 development scenes, each with base scores from 92-feature models trained on the other 4
split.terminal_base_score: 92-feature ensemble fit on all 5 development scenes
split.upstream_candidate_tables: fixed scene-cross-fitted tables; not regenerated inside every outer/nested fold

inference.outside_topk: keep base score, then include in scene-wide percentile ranking
inference.output_score: average-tie percentile of blended scores within full scene scoring union

environment_inspected_today.AdamW_signature: (params: collections.abc.Iterable[torch.Tensor] | collections.abc.Iterable[dict[str, typing.Any]] | collections.abc.Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]], lr: float | torch.Tensor = 0.001, betas: tuple[float | torch.Tensor, float | torch.Tensor] = (0.9, 0.999), eps: float = 1e-08, weight_decay: float = 0.01, amsgrad: bool = False, *, maximize: bool = False, foreach: bool | None = None, capturable: bool = False, differentiable: bool = False, fused: bool | None = None) -> None
environment_inspected_today.LayerNorm_signature: (normalized_shape: int | list[int] | torch.Size, eps: float = 1e-05, elementwise_affine: bool = True, bias: bool = True, device=None, dtype=None) -> None

numerical_limits: Full refitting was not executed in this investigation. CPU/CUDA and GPU-type equality is not guaranteed. Historical GPU backend flags/driver state were not archived in the paper fit audit.
